fix.example: 我弟弟屬狗，跟我差了十二歲。
fix.exampleEn: My younger brother was born in the Year of the Dog; he's twelve years younger than me.

reason: 屬狗與二十四歲年份矛盾，改為不會過時的說法

fix.example: 手機要更新了，記得先充好電。
fix.exampleEn: Your phone needs to update, so remember to charge it first.

reason: 「先幫我充電一下」因果不自然

fix.example: 不要隨便看別人的手機，要尊重隱私。
fix.exampleEn: Don't look at other people's phones; respect their privacy.

reason: 「這是隱私」語意不完整，不自然

fix.example: 他吃壞肚子，晚上一直嘔吐。
fix.exampleEn: He ate something bad and kept throwing up all night.

reason: 「想嘔吐」口語與書面混搭，口語說「想吐」；改用嘔吐較自然的語境

fix.example: 台灣的河流又短又急。
fix.exampleEn: Rivers in Taiwan are short and fast-flowing.

reason: 「這條河流」偏生硬，口語說「這條河」

fix.example: 他戒了菸，從此身體越來越好。
fix.exampleEn: He quit smoking, and from then on his health kept getting better.

reason: 「以後」與「從此」語意重複

fix.example: 我在市場買了一串香蕉。
fix.exampleEn: I bought a bunch of bananas at the market.

reason: 烤香腸台灣說「一根／一支」，不用「一串」

fix.example: 他們之間產生了一些誤會。
fix.exampleEn: Some misunderstandings arose between them.

reason: 「產生壓力」搭配較弱，改用常見搭配

fix.example: 台灣北部屬於亞熱帶氣候。
fix.exampleEn: Northern Taiwan has a subtropical climate.

reason: 「機車屬於我哥哥」是翻譯腔，台灣會說「是我哥哥的」

fix.example: 這個社區缺少讓小孩玩的地方。
fix.exampleEn: This neighborhood lacks places for kids to play.

reason: 「這道菜缺少一點鹽」不自然，口語說「少了一點鹽」

fix.example: 他的手臂很粗，看起來很有力。
fix.exampleEn: His arms are thick; he looks really strong.

reason: 繩子太粗「綁不起來」邏輯不順

fix.example: 這條路不平，騎車要小心。
fix.exampleEn: This road is uneven, so be careful riding.

reason: 「不太平」易與「太平」混淆

fix.example: 爸爸平常很少發脾氣，今天怎麼了？
fix.exampleEn: Dad hardly ever loses his temper. What's going on today?

reason: 「很少發脾氣，今天卻很生氣」語意重複

fix.example: 爸媽都為你感到很驕傲。
fix.exampleEn: Your parents are very proud of you.

reason: 語序不自然，應為「為你感到很驕傲」

fix.example: 在國外的時候，我常常思念家人。
fix.exampleEn: When I was abroad, I often missed my family.

reason: 「思念食物」搭配不當，思念多用於人或家鄉

fix.example: 她年紀輕輕就有這麼大的成就。
fix.exampleEn: She's achieved so much at such a young age.

reason: 例句用的是「成就感」，非詞目本義

fix.example: 你每天加班到半夜，小心過勞！
fix.exampleEn: You work overtime until midnight every day. Watch out for overwork!

reason: 對第三人稱說「小心過勞」不自然

fix.exampleEn: The restaurant at the entrance to our lane went out of business last month.

reason: 「巷口」英譯錯成 end of the lane

fix.example: 你名片上的職稱是什麼？

reason: 「你的名片上的」雙「的」累贅

fix.example: 董事長在股東會上宣布了好消息。
fix.exampleEn: The chairman announced good news at the shareholders' meeting.

reason: 台灣公司少說「年會」，改用「股東會」

fix.example: 犯罪的人應該受到處罰。
fix.exampleEn: People who commit crimes should be punished.

reason: 例句用的是「犯罪率」，非詞目本義

fix.exampleEn: He had his bag snatched on the street.

reason: 主詞是「他」，英譯 purse 不妥
釋義 volunteer 不準確，應為「義務的（無償的）」

fix.example: 今天股價下跌，他心情很不好。
fix.exampleEn: Stock prices fell today, and he's in a bad mood.

reason: 「股票下跌」不自然，應說「股價下跌」

fix.example: 全球的氣溫越來越高了。
fix.exampleEn: Temperatures around the world keep rising.

reason: 「全球的天氣越來越熱」不自然，應說氣溫
